sync_reset: reset clears q to 0 and overrides increment
reset value is unspecified or non-zero
Reset loads a non-zero BCD value such as 9999 instead of 0.
upper_digit_enables: ena bit0=tens enable, bit1=hundreds enable, bit2=thousands enable, combinational from q
ena bits use reversed digit ordering or are registered on posedge
ena is registered on posedge from pre-edge q, so ena remains 0 when q becomes 9 until the next edge.
bcd_increment: increments by one as a 4-digit BCD number modulo 10000 on posedge clk
down-counts or has unspecified increment direction/modulus/timing
Down-count by 1 modulo 10000 on each enabled posedge.
